authorization: User authorized method redesign. This is natural-change behavior reconstruction, not clinical progression, FW6 or the stopped synthetic local trial.
motivation: Two previous methods improved cross-sectional level approximation but did not establish individual-change increment. Test whether matching the training target to observed output differences improves this property.
source_pairs: Use all218 pairs in frozen source feasibility manifest; no replacement, trimming, additional visits or diagnosis-based selection.
target: For each frozen target-domain/configuration ensemble, logit(mean calibrated followup probability)-logit(mean calibrated anchor probability); original5 seeds, clipping[1e-4,1-1e-4].
source_inference: Replay existing290 frozen checkpoints on source followups only; reuse saved teacher-consistent baseline probabilities. No new MRI training/calibration.
features: Replay identical baseline-outside-target-domain concept transforms and reference; verify frozen baseline feature values. Four severity deltas or scalar reference-logit delta. No elapsed time, extra ROI, interaction or new disease label input.

models.LEVEL_AD4: Previously saved exact-teacher source level reconstruction; apply its linear coefficients to feature differences. No refit.
models.DELTA_AD4: Train StandardScaler(with_mean=False)+Ridge(alpha=1,fit_intercept=False) on four feature deltas and teacher-logit deltas. Zero feature change gives zero estimated change.
models.DELTA_REF1: Same training people, target, scaling and fixed ridge settings on reference-logit delta alone.

source_evaluation: For each target domain and configuration, fit change model on all source pairs outside target domain; evaluate all available pairs in target domain. Check original teacher membership excludes target participants. No hyperparameter selection.
primary: Equal participant-weight mean absolute change error, averaging available configurations within person.
gate: Both comparisons: at least10% relative MAE reduction,95% paired participant interval lower>0,and at least7/9 configuration directions. Same pragmatic development criterion, not a clinical effect threshold.
second_stage_if_source_passes: Apply frozen delta fits to the existing402 confirmation natural pairs using already saved equivalent feature transforms and MRI outputs. Same two comparisons/gates. No target-dependent refit, tuning or exclusion. Source and confirmation people are disjoint but the confirmation outcomes were previously inspected; describe as exploratory reuse.
stop: If either source or second-stage gate fails, retain the candidate and all results but stop its advancement; no automatic regularization/ROI/window search.
limits: Operational sample floors are not power
Teacher trained on source participants: behavior distillation target only, not unbiased source diagnostic error
No human benefit, molecular specificity, causal fidelity, independent validation or75-80 attainment follows automatically
